para.text: Suppose you have a graph with an aspect ratio (the ratio of the lengths of the Y and X axes) of 3:4 (a normal value), and both X and Y axes have an indicated scale of 0 to 100.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: The X-axis will always be plotted with the indicated scale, from 0 to 100.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;

text.style: font-family:'Times New Roman'; font-size:12pt; text-decoration:underline; color:#000000;

para.text: is called with a negative or zero ratio (or not called at all) the Y-axis will also be plotted with the indicated scale of 0 to 100.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: If the ratio is set to 1 the Y-axis will be plotted with a scale of 12.5 to 87.5, giving the same ‘length per pixel’ value as for the X-axis.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: If the ratio is set to 2, the scale will be from -25 to 125, giving the double length per pixel value.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: Similarly, if the ratio is set to 0.5, the scale will be from 31.25 to 68.75.
